title: AgentEnrollResponse
description: The `data` payload of the Response envelope for POST /enroll.

deviceId.description: Server-issued opaque device id. The agent stores this and uses it as identity forever.

resumeSupported.description: Optional (protocol 1.9). true from servers that resume enrollments: the agent may then recover credentials the server refuses before its first check-in with a resumeOnly enroll of the same attempt. Absent from older servers.
